entries.name: unevaluated-create-avl-tree-v0-reject-tx#26
entries.description: The four-value CreateAvlTree layout at tree version 0, UNSIZED. Its fourth field is a `None: Option[Int]` CONSTANT, and rule 1009 (`CheckSerializableTypeCode`) refuses that data value at v0 — type code 36. With no size bit there is nothing to degrade behind, so the carrier is REJECTED. The JVM will not WRITE this tree at v0 either (its serializer re-enters the version context at the tree's own version), so the bytes are composed; the v3 twin above is the accepted form.

entries.name: unevaluated-old-layout-v0-reject-tx#27
entries.description: CreateAvlTree in the fork's OLD layout — three values and then a bare `00` where the fourth value belongs. `00` is read as a type prefix and `TypeSerializer` has no type code 0 (`:138`): REJECTED. This is the arm that tells the two layouts apart.

entries.name: unevaluated-old-layout-v3-reject-tx#28
entries.description: The same old layout, SIZE-FLAGGED at v3 — still REJECTED. An `InvalidTypePrefix` is not a ValidationException, so the size bit does not degrade it: the pair pins that the layout error is fatal at every version, unlike a missing opcode.

entries.name: unevaluated-bool-operand-v0-reject-tx#29
entries.description: `BitShiftLeft(true, 2)` at v0: `BitOp`'s `require(left.tpe.isNumTypeOrNoType && ...)` throws an IllegalArgumentException at BUILD, inside the parse. Note what the JVM then SAYS: `deserializeErgoTree` rethrows any IAE as `SerializerException("Tree version (0) is above activated script version (3)")` (`ErgoTreeSerializer.scala:191-193`) — a message hard-coded for an unrelated hypothesis. The real reason, `invalid types left:SBoolean, right:SInt`, survives only as the CAUSE. Match on classes, not messages.

entries.name: unevaluated-bool-operand-v3-reject-tx#30
entries.description: The same Boolean operand SIZE-FLAGGED at v3 — still REJECTED, and this is the half worth having: the IAE is rethrown inside the inner try, BEFORE the catch that turns a ValidationException into a degrade, so the size bit cannot save a failed build check.

entries.name: unevaluated-spip-filter-v0-reject-tx#31
entries.description: `sigmaProp(SigmaPropIsProven(Filter(1, (x: Int) => true)))`: SigmaPropIsProven is the one of the thirteen whose build check reads a child's TYPE (`val opType`), and `Filter.tpe` casts SInt to SCollection — a ClassCastException, not a ValidationException, so no degrade. The companion of the PropertyCall receiver-type family: the same cast, reached through a node that never evaluates.
